name: Standard Employment Visa (2-year, employer-sponsored)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a job offer from a UAE-licensed employer, who bears 100% of visa/permit costs and must register the contract with MOHRE within 14 days and enrol the worker in the Wages Protection System.

evidence_required.document: Medical fitness test and Emirates ID application

outcome.duration_length: 2 years (1 year for employees aged 60+), renewable while employed

sources.title: Working in the private sector - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: FAMILY SPONSORSHIP THRESHOLD CONFIRMED at AED 4,000/month, or AED 3,000 + employer-provided accommodation — job-title restrictions on this were removed in the 2019/2022 reform. Mainland labour cards are valid 2 years by default (1 year for workers aged 60+); free-zone permits run 1-3 years depending on the specific zone. Emiratisation compliance affects per-permit fees for mainland employers (Category 1 firms pay materially lower fees) but does not itself restrict individual expatriate hiring — a distinction worth surfacing since 'Emiratisation quota' is sometimes misunderstood as a hard hiring cap rather than a fee/compliance-tier mechanism. Same structural ceiling as every other UAE route: no PR, no citizenship path — this is the standard baseline work route most expatriates use, feeding upward into Green Visa (salary ≥AED 15,000 + occupational level 1-3) or directly into Golden Visa (salary ≥AED 30,000) once thresholds are met.
